validation.official_reference_description: Hubei statistics yearbook table17-1 lists Xiantao land area2538km2 (2022/2023); used only for plausibility, not to rescale polygon.
identity_checks: Unique source shapeName Xiantaoshi and country CHN
bbox in Jianghan Plain, Hubei, consistent with official Xiantao geographic extent
polygon area approximately2511.38km2 vs official reference2538km2; about1.05 percent difference

limitations: 2017 reference boundary, not asserted to be the authoritative2021 or current administrative boundary.
72-vertex generalized polygon; boundary positional uncertainty affects fine-resolution class-area totals.
Source feature has no parent province attribute; Hubei association was independently cross-referenced by name, location and official statistics.
Computed mask area must not be rescaled to force the official2538km2 figure.
WorldCover2021 class40 within this reference polygon is a2021 land-cover classification estimate, not current official cultivated-land holdings, sown area or high-standard farmland.
